nodes.description: Private _owner address in Ownable; account authorised by the onlyOwner modifier.
Private _lp address; every transfer whose recipient equals _lp is silently refused (blacklist/honeypot target).
Public BURN_RATE = 2 used as the transfer fee percentage.
_minimumSupply threshold below which the burn fee branch is skipped.
Total token supply mutated by _mint and _burn and read in _transfer.
Mapping of account balances mutated by _transfer, _mint and _burn.
Nested allowance mapping written by _approve and read by transferFrom.
AccessControl roles mapping backing hasRole, grantRole and revokeRole.
ERC20 transfer: returns false when recipient == _lp, otherwise calls _transfer with msg.sender as sender.
ERC20 transferFrom: refuses recipient == _lp, otherwise _transfer plus allowance reduction via _approve.
Admin-only setter that assigns the blocked _lp address.
Internal _transfer applying the optional burn fee driven by BURN_RATE and _minimumSupply.
Internal _mint increasing _totalSupply and the recipient balance.
Internal _burn decreasing _totalSupply and the account balance.
Internal _approve writing the _allowances mapping and emitting Approval.
AccessControl grantRole guarded by a check that msg.sender holds the role admin role.
Ownable renounceOwnership guarded by onlyOwner, clears _owner.
CMERC20Snapshot snapshot() guarded by SNAPSHOT_ROLE held by msg.sender.
Context._msgSender returning the untrusted msg.sender value.
msg.sender - caller-controlled address used for authorisation and balance debiting.
Address.sendValue forwarding all available gas to the recipient with a low-level value call.
recipient.call{value: amount}("") low-level value transfer with no reentrancy protection.
target.call{value: weiValue}(data) low-level call executed against an arbitrary target.
Address._functionCallWithValue performing the low-level call and bubbling revert data.
Ownable transferOwnership guarded by onlyOwner, reassigns _owner.
amount.mul(BURN_RATE).div(PERCENTS_DIVIDER) fee computation inside _transfer.
SafeMath sub/add balance and totalSupply updates inside _transfer.
BOOMswapV3 constructor: sets decimals, mints the initial supply and grants DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE and SNAPSHOT_ROLE to the deployer.
recipient parameter of transfer(address,uint256).
amount parameter of transfer(address,uint256).
sender parameter of transferFrom(address,address,uint256).
recipient parameter of transferFrom(address,address,uint256).
amount parameter of transferFrom(address,address,uint256).
recipient parameter of setLP(address), stored into _lp.
sender parameter of internal _transfer(address,address,uint256).
recipient parameter of internal _transfer(address,address,uint256).
amount parameter of internal _transfer(address,address,uint256).
remainingAmount local variable in _transfer holding the amount after the burn fee.
burnAmount local variable in _transfer holding the computed fee.
account parameter of internal _burn(address,uint256).
value parameter of internal _burn(address,uint256).
account parameter of internal _mint(address,uint256).
value parameter of internal _mint(address,uint256).
newOwner parameter of transferOwnership(address).
msgSender local variable in the Ownable constructor holding _msgSender().

edges.reason: transfer recipient parameter selects the destination of the balance update.
transfer amount parameter is the value forwarded to _transfer.
transfer returns false whenever recipient equals the _lp address.
transfer delegates the balance update to the internal _transfer.
msg.sender is the debited account when transfer is called directly.
transferFrom sender parameter is the debited account.
transferFrom recipient parameter is checked against _lp.
transferFrom amount parameter drives both _transfer and allowance reduction.
transferFrom delegates to the internal _transfer.
transferFrom reduces the allowance via _approve.
transferFrom is silently blocked when recipient equals _lp.
setLP stores the recipient parameter into the _lp state variable.
an admin can set the _lp address that blocks all transfers to it.
setLP requires hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, msg.sender).
_transfer sender parameter is the account whose balance is decremented.
_transfer recipient parameter is the account whose balance is incremented.
_transfer amount parameter is split between burn and remaining transfer.
remainingAmount local accumulates the amount after fee subtraction.
burnAmount local is derived from amount and BURN_RATE.
BURN_RATE state variable is read to compute the transfer fee.
_minimumSupply gates whether the burn fee branch executes.
_totalSupply is compared against _minimumSupply before burning.
sender and recipient balances are rewritten using SafeMath.
_transfer calls _burn for the computed burn fee.
_transfer executes the mul/div fee arithmetic on untrusted amount.
_transfer performs SafeMath sub/add on balances and supply.
_burn account parameter identifies the balance to reduce.
_burn value parameter is subtracted from balance and total supply.
_burn reduces the account balance in _balances.
_burn reduces _totalSupply.
_mint account parameter receives the minted balance.
_mint value parameter is added to balance and total supply.
_mint increases _totalSupply.
_mint increases the recipient balance in _balances.
transferOwnership newOwner parameter becomes the new _owner.
onlyOwner requires _owner == msg.sender before ownership transfer.
transferOwnership reassigns the privileged _owner state variable.
onlyOwner restricts renounceOwnership to msg.sender == _owner.
renounceOwnership sets _owner to the zero address.
grantRole validates that msg.sender holds the role admin role.
grantRole mutates the _roles mapping.
snapshot() requires SNAPSHOT_ROLE for msg.sender.
snapshot authorisation is resolved through the _roles mapping.
sendValue hands control to the recipient through a low-level value call.
the recipient can reenter the caller of sendValue before state is finalised.
_functionCallWithValue performs an arbitrary low-level call to target.
the target contract can reenter the calling contract through the low-level call.
_msgSender simply returns the untrusted msg.sender value.
the constructor captures _msgSender() into the msgSender local variable.
the deployer captured in the local becomes the initial _owner and admin.
the constructor local mirrors the untrusted msg.sender input.
the constructor mints the initial supply via _mint.

normalization_plan.reason: recipient parameter of transfer only routes the call and can be folded into the transfer function node.
amount parameter of transfer is only forwarded to _transfer and can be folded into the transfer function node.
sender parameter of transferFrom is only used to debit the source account, fold into transferFrom.
recipient parameter of transferFrom is only compared with _lp, fold into transferFrom.
amount parameter of transferFrom only feeds _transfer and allowance math, fold into transferFrom.
recipient parameter of setLP is stored directly into _lp, fold into setLP.
sender parameter of internal _transfer is only a local alias for the caller, fold into _transfer.
recipient parameter of internal _transfer is only a local alias, fold into _transfer.
amount parameter of internal _transfer is only the value being split, fold into _transfer.
remainingAmount is a short-lived accumulator inside _transfer, fold into the function node.
burnAmount is the direct result of the mul/div fee arithmetic, fold into the unsafe arithmetic operation.
account parameter of _burn is only the balance holder to reduce, fold into _burn.
value parameter of _burn is only the amount removed from balance and supply, fold into _burn.
account parameter of _mint is only the beneficiary of the created supply, fold into _mint.
value parameter of _mint is only the created amount, fold into _mint.
newOwner parameter of transferOwnership is written straight into _owner, fold into transferOwnership.
msgSender constructor local is a one-shot alias of _msgSender() used for role setup, fold into the constructor.
